notablePrerequisites: Your combined devotion to green and white is at least 5.
description:
Activate Trazyn using Nyx Lotus's ability by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G} or {W}{W}{W}{W}{W}.
Activate Seedcradle Witch by paying {2}{G}{W}, untapping Trazyn and giving it +3/+3 until end of turn.
Repeat.
